request: Among the audit channels C1, C2, and C3, find a message that got a reaction from someone named Alex, and tell me which workspace that channel belongs to.

selection_plan.identifying_path: WORKSPACE ← CONVERSATION (in audit list, readable) ← MESSAGE ← REACTION → USER, focal condition on USER.real_name matching 'Alex'
criteria: focal: reaction's user.real_name denotes a person named Alex
auxiliary: conversation is one of the supplied audit channel IDs and its complete history is readable by the actor

resolution_plan.justification: Exactly one audit channel contains a message with a reaction from a real user named Alex; that channel's workspace is the unique answer. A second Alex reacting on a different message in the same channel is included to confirm dedup is by workspace identity, not by reaction/user count.

negatives: Channel C2: message authored by Alex Patel (real_name 'Alex Patel') but reacted to only by Priya Shah — Alex appears as author, not as reactor, so the focal reaction-by-Alex condition fails despite an 'Alex' being present on the message.

Channel C3: message reacted to by Alexis Turner (real_name 'Alexis Turner') — name superficially contains 'Alex' but is not the name Alex, testing exact name-field matching rather than substring matching.
negative_plan.auxiliaries_satisfied_by_negatives: Both negatives sit in supplied audit channels readable by the actor and have genuine messages with genuine reactions, satisfying every auxiliary condition while failing the focal real_name-is-Alex-as-reactor condition.

environment_plan: Three workspaces W1, W2, W3 each own one audit channel (C1 in W1, C2 in W2, C3 in W3), all readable by the actor. C1 holds two messages: one reacted to by Alex Chen and another reacted to by a second real Alex (Alex Wong), both mapping to the same workspace W1 to test dedup-by-workspace. C2 holds a message authored by Alex Patel but reacted to only by Priya Shah (relationship near miss). C3 holds a message reacted to only by Alexis Turner (name near miss). No other channels/messages are needed; keep member lists and timestamps minimal but concrete.
action_plan: Single read-only task: scan the histories of the three named audit channels for reactions, match reactor real_name to 'Alex', and report the workspace owning the qualifying channel.
